dedupe_keys.name: data for experimental data about the evacuation of preschool children from nursery schools part ii movement characteristics and behaviour

description: Hana Najmanová and Enrico Ronchi publish movement measurements from 15 evacuation drills in ten Czech nursery schools, involving 970 children aged three to seven and 87 staff members. Zenodo serves twelve CSV tables under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. The tables separate corridors, doors, straight and spiral staircases, with speed, flow and density values and age-group or walking-versus-running labels. These relationships can calibrate pedestrian movement rules in school evacuation simulations and test sensitivity to child age and route element. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this measured dataset. A limitation is that supervised drills differ from a real fire or other emergency; children, staffing and geometry in another school may also differ. The detailed field notes are on the deposit page, but no CSV was downloaded, so row counts, outliers and measurement uncertainty were not recalculated.
